title: Add post-cleaning action splitting pass for long bullets

requirements.text: Implement a second processing pass that runs after initial note cleaning and formatting but before displaying output in the Clean Notes section. This pass should detect bullet points containing more than 10 words with multiple academic action phrases and no commas or conjunctions, then split them into multiple meaningful action-based bullet points based on noun-action sequence patterns.

quotes: After the note has been cleaned and formatted and before it is displayed in the Clean Notes output section, run a second processing pass.
Detect any bullet point that: - contains more than 10 words - contains multiple academic action phrases - contains no comma or conjunction

acceptanceCriteria: Second processing pass runs after initial cleaning/formatting but before display
Detects bullets with 10+ words, multiple action phrases, and no commas/conjunctions
Splits detected bullets into multiple action-based bullets preserving full meaning
Example: 'Helps in gas exchange in lungs removal of waste substances from cells distribution of nutrients in the body.' becomes three separate bullets
Final output displays only after second-pass processing completes

requirements.text: Apply the action splitting logic only to Convert Paragraph to Points and Definition Style Format modes. Do not apply it to other formatting modes or affect heading detection.

quotes: Apply this only inside: - Convert Paragraph to Points - Definition Style Format

acceptanceCriteria: Action splitting only applies when Convert Paragraph to Points is selected
Action splitting only applies when Definition Style Format is selected

requirements.text: Identify action phrase boundaries using verb changes, noun phrase starts, and functional academic keywords including: helps, removal, distribution, movement, absorption, transport, formation, release, regulation, maintenance. Split each detected action phrase into a separate bullet point while preserving compound scientific terms.

quotes: Split this bullet into multiple meaningful action-based bullet points based on noun-action sequence patterns.
Helps in gas exchange in lungs - Removal of waste substances from cells - Distribution of nutrients in the body.

acceptanceCriteria: Algorithm detects action phrase boundaries using verb changes
Algorithm recognizes noun phrase starts as boundaries
Algorithm identifies academic keywords: helps, removal, distribution, movement, absorption, transport, formation, release, regulation, maintenance
Each action phrase becomes a separate bullet point
Compound scientific terms are not split apart
Full meaning of each phrase is preserved in the split

constraints: Do not modify heading detection logic
Do not affect UI layout or components
Preserve existing functionality in notesCleanerFormat.ts for other formatting modes
Do not split compound scientific terms
nonGoals: Modifying other formatting modes beyond Convert Paragraph to Points and Definition Style Format
Changing the UI or output section display logic
